title: Quality-tier evidence gate (40 flagship end-to-end vs the smoke-tested remainder)
question: Implement the two-tier contract - at least 40 flagship workflows with full end-to-end tests, every remaining workflow executable, schema-valid, documented and smoke-tested - as a gate that resolves each tier claim to the test artifacts that back it on disk. Question: for each blueprint claiming flagship tier, which end-to-end test file and which passing run id proves it, and how many claims resolve to nothing?
mechanism: tier claim -> on-disk test-artifact resolution with UNPROVEN as a distinct outcome from PROVEN, DEMOTE, and FAIL

library_source.note: This worktree has no harvested 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.json. The gate is implemented and proven on a 96-entry fixture estate (40 flagship + 56 remainder). This is not a certification of the absent Windows harvest library.
